limitations: This is a task-local prototype and is not wired into production generation or approval metadata.
Evidence covers three declared depths at one retained seed, not every lawful input.
Output dimensions make the bounded depth alternatives easy to identify; this tests rule variation, not resistance to all imaginable shortcuts.
Finite demonstrations eliminate the two declared parameter rivals, not every possible crop rule.

parameter.input_constraints: every retained input has at least two rows above and below the gray bbox, canonical one-row halo evidence, and added blue evidence in the two-row halo
parameter.meaning: number of rows retained above and below the gray-marker bounding box
parameter.name: halo_depth

0.source:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((fives (find-color g 5))
                  (rs (map first fives))
                  (cs (map second fives))
                  (r1 (min-list rs))
                  (c1 (min-list cs))
                  (r2 (max-list rs))
                  (c2 (max-list cs)))
             (subgrid g r1 c1 r2 c2)))))
